historicalBoundary.unfinishedDrafts: retained on original device, not falsely represented as prior cloud completion

recoveries.finding: Initial migration test expected an incomplete local round in server-validated completed history
recoveries.resolution: Correct the assertion to local snapshot preservation and no fabricated synced history; unchanged runtime validation.

recoveries.finding: Windows WebKit page assertions ran while protected course was still preparing
recoveries.resolution: Retain original failing runs and isolate; explicit public readiness then the original count/name/date assertion. Observed one cold preparation was 13587ms. Subsequent test contexts also carry mobile profile. Initial run also overlapped content wording/diagram edits; not described as exact-version isolation.

recoveries.finding: One later re-entry assertion still ran before ready
recoveries.resolution: Use the same public readiness phase after directory re-entry; 404 target changed to the new unique Penny asset and actual failed response must be observed.

recoveries.finding: Newly mounted two-loaves.svg sampled before decode
recoveries.resolution: Same-version isolation reproduced complete=false,width=0; record the pending path and await the unchanged decode condition. An intermediate patch targeted a different identical line; final fix applied at the failing grammar step.

recoveries.finding: First reference compositions placed second hammer and chocolate beside landmarks
recoveries.resolution: Create actual occlusion; inspect all 12 relation diagrams. Counter coordinate system and foreground hand also corrected.

recoveries.finding: pypdf extraction inserted whitespace inside Nunito words
recoveries.resolution: Original two rendered pages reviewed; verify letters/order after whitespace normalization and retain raw extraction. No PDF content changed.

scope: Scoped development tests, two engines and two authenticated mounts. Original 11 frozen-page Chromium checks and adjacent 41–42 migration included. No full repository commit or release verification.
